entries.original: Memory sync on a CLI sign-in recovers after the OS credential store briefly reads empty (a locked keychain, a racing writer). The operations that saw the empty read are still refused, but the next sync pass gets a live account instead of staying off until restart. A real sign-out or credential change still stops sync (#11812). ([#12001](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12001))

entries.original: On Windows, `omo host ensure` forwards a private pipe pair through the npm launcher, Bun re-exec, and provisioned-runtime handoff. Both pipe handles travel together on their original stdio slots, and the waiting launcher closes its owned copies after spawning. Invalid or aliased pairs remain null declarations; POSIX socket forwarding is unchanged. ([#11958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11958))
entries.translated: On Windows, `omo host ensure` forwards a private pipe pair through the npm launcher, Bun re-exec, and provisioned-runtime handoff. Both pipe handles travel together on their original stdio slots, and the waiting launcher closes its owned copies after spawning. Invalid or aliased pairs remain null declarations; POSIX socket forwarding is unchanged. ([#11958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11958))

entries.original: Memory git failures that end without any output now say how the git process ended (exit code, signal and elapsed time) instead of a bare exit code. On macOS and Linux the signal tells an externally killed git apart from a silent git error; on Windows a killed child reports no signal, so there the elapsed time is the only clue. ([#11945](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11945))

entries.original: The compiled-worker relocation test no longer hangs now and then. Its fixture waited on `terminate()` from inside the worker's message handler, which races the worker's own exit and never settles on Bun 1.4.4. It now waits for the worker's clean exit after the ready message, and a timeout failure reports its signal. ([#11941](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11941), fixes [#11940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11940))

entries.original: Memory `/doctor` no longer tells the user to "fix the cause" of parked facts batches without naming it: the facts check now reads as a plain-words to-do (run `/facts retry` for a transient cause such as a timeout, or the named fix such as setting `memory.facts.model`), followed by the cause counts per parked batch and the newest parked batch's run log path, and `/facts retry` reports how many batches it unparked and whether any parked again, with the cause. ([#11909](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11909), part of [#10897](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10897))

entries.original: The `omo-ai` installer and launcher no longer rewrite the Claude Code version the engine advertised on Anthropic OAuth requests: senpi removed that request path together with the declaration the rewrite looked for (senpi#5131), so engine preparation keeps only the compile-safe css-tree data and the RPC stream guard, and an engine without the declaration no longer fails preparation with "unsupported Senpi". ([#11964](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11964))

entries.original: Categories and agents can set `models_distribution: "round_robin"` alongside `models` to spread new task children across their configured model chains. The default `sequential` policy keeps the existing order. Each child's fallback chain wraps from its selected starting model without repeating models, and continuations keep their current model. ([#11905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11905))

entries.original: Computer use (macOS): `type()` into a window that shows another computer or device (Screen Sharing, iPhone Mirroring) sends the keys of the current keyboard layout, since such a window receives key codes rather than typed text; every character is mapped before anything is sent, and a character no key types fails `InvalidKey` with nothing typed. In the background, text into a Screen Sharing window that needs Shift or Option fails `BackgroundUnavailable` before the first key (it takes modifiers from the physical keyboard; use foreground delivery), and `el.type()` never inserts into a remote window. ([#11749](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11749), part of [#11466](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11466))

In the background, text into a Screen Sharing window that needs Shift or Option fails `BackgroundUnavailable` before the first key (it takes modifiers from the physical keyboard; use foreground delivery), and `el.type()` never inserts into a remote window. entries.original: Command Code is now offered during setup as a custom provider: when `CMD_API_KEY` (or `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`) is present in the environment, setup writes a keyless models.json provider entry covering both Command Code wires (Anthropic messages and OpenAI-compatible chat completions) and stores the key reference in auth.json, so agents can use Command Code models without manual provider configuration (#11326). ([#11326](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11326))
